Foorara is a Nopon in . He is first found near Bower Lounge in the Argentum Trade Guild, but is found throughout the game in each of the major Titans, depending on progress made in Foorara's Walky-Walky. Upon completing this informal quest, Foorara is revealed to be the heir to the Voltis Trade Guild, the second largest Nopon Guild behind Argentum. Foorara's quest is the same as that undertaken by Dekudeku four hundred and ninety four years prior.

Flurrycombs are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Cosmetipolitan in the Grodd Residential Zone of Torigoth in the Gormott Province. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Poppi QTπ. Two must be used to unlock Poppi QTπ's Level 3 Keen Eye.

The Forgotten Waste (Japanese: , Wasurerareta Chi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Gormott Province and is where Rex and Pyra first arrive on Gormott. It leads directly to Wrecc Marshland. There are no enemies here except during Into the Open Sky. There is a Heart-to-Heart ("The Real Gramps") and a Treasure Trove here. A Salvage Point also becomes available here during Upgrades and Tinkering.
The Fonsa Myma Gate (Japanese: , Fonsu Maimu Seimon) is a Landmark in . It is the main entrance to Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
The Fonsa Myma Port (Japanese: , Fonsu Maimu-kō) is a Landmark in . It is located in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya, on the side opposite the main entrance.

The Fonsa Myma Waters (Japanese: , Fonsu Maimu Suiiki) are a location in . They are located in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, directly below the Ruins of Fountain Park and south of Farlaine Central Pools. The Coralline Sanctum can be found to their east.
The Fount of Holy Light (Japanese: , Shinkō no Funsui) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Refugee Campground in the Indoline Praetorium.

Flames of Justice (Japanese: , Seigi no Honō) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received at the Uraya Merc Barracks of Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya, after awakening Godfrey and advancing his Affinity Chart.
Freshening Gels are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Cleo's Cosmetics in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Fonsett-Rouge Lipglosses are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Aquaneze Cosmetics in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Fonsan Violas are Instrument Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Vibrattio Instruments in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Perun.
Fondant Rice Cakes are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Platini Deli in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Aegaeon.
Fried Octomayo is a Staple Food Pouch item in . It can be purchased from Platini Deli in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. It is one of Pandoria's favorite Pouch items.

|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Forrestones are Ore collectibles in and . They can be found in the Gormott Province and Gormott. They can also be found in the Indoline Praetorium, in the tunnel north of the Fount of Holy Light. In the , Forrestones can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
The Fourth Ridge Entrance (Japanese: , 4-gōtō Entoransu) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Fragrant Samod Stralus are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Speck Butchers in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Flanck Lysaats (Japanese: , Burakku Shīsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lysaat family, and can be found at level 18-23 at the north end of the Acid Gullet and just north of Gullet Pass in the Head of the Kingdom of Uraya. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Vale's level 2 Tainted Palace.

Froga Gyannas (Japanese: , Furogā Gyanomu) are enemies in . They are members of the Gyanna family, and can be found at level 34-36 at Battlescar Cove or Overlook Hill in Temperantia. Three of them must be defeated to unlock T-elos's level 3 "Heartbreaker" on her affinity chart.

Fresh Rodonyas (Japanese: , Furesshu Mūsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Rodonya family, and can be found at level 37-42 in the Kingdom of Tantal, at Memorial Ruins in the Head or Amphoret Pillar on the Upper Level. They can be summoned at Level 38-40 by Nant Buloofo and level 40-42 by Muscley Damian's arts "Beast Howl". Six of them must be defeated to unlock Aegaeon's level 2 Breaking Wave, and five of them must be defeated to unlock Praxis's level 2 "Water Mastery".

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Friendship Rings are accessories in and . They increase the HP restored when reviving a teammate by up to 29% of their maximum health. The Affection Ring and Promise Ring accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect. It can stack with the additive HP recovering effects of the teammate's Grandarbor Ward, Spirit Tree Ward or World Tree Ward accessories.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Fluffy Hats (Japanese: , Fusafusa Hatto) are accessories in and . They increase the wearer's Ether stat by up to 22. The Fabulous Hat accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect. For a similar multiplicative effect that can stack with this gear, check the Bolt Hat, Pearl Hat, Fiber Hat and Prairie Cap accessories. Other sources of Ether apply before this fixed stat bonus.

Fluffy Snow Bugs are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, specifically at the Collection Point west-southwest of the Little Banerro Ruins. In the , Fluffy Snow Bugs can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Foolin' Ivies are Tree collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, in particular on the closest south Collection Point located between the Central Ether Boulder and Genbu Drifts. In the , Foolin' Ivies can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Fragrant Shrimps are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, in particular from the "Ichthyology" Collection Points in Zalmor's Crevice and Yolmunder's Crevasse. In the , Fragrant Shrimps can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Freezing Chameleons are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal, specifically at the Collection Point west-southwest of the Little Banerro Ruins. In the , Freezing Chameleons can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Fool's Gold (Japanese: , Kane wa Tenka no Mawarimono ka?, Money Comes and Goes) is a Blade Quest in . It is Sheba's Blade Quest and can be started by saving 1,000,000 G in Sheba's piggy bank and then visiting the Little Garden of Tradition in the Leftherian Archipelago. After having a short rest in Lemour Inn with Sheba in the party, a cutscene begins and she provides a hint to go to Central Exchange where the Heart-to-Heart "Sheba's Dream" begins. After this mission is completed the Merc Missions series Sheba's Tea Party 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 are unlocked in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Flash Daggers are Treasure items in '. They can be obtained through Salvaging at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Floating Armies are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at Port Anangham, or can be purchased from the Belchett Recycling shop at Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Fleet-in-a-Bottle are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the Dalnes Stone in Temperantia.

Flower Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be dropped by a variety of low-level enemies in the Leftherian Archipelago. In they can be bought from Capital Weapons or dropped be several enemies. Flower Chips share their appearance with Forest Chips, Glass Chips, and Wood Chips. __TOC__

Fluorite Chips are Core Chips in . They can only be obtained from one reliable enemy source, and two DLC quests. Fluorite Chips share their appearance with Spinel Chips, Amethyst Chips and Turquoise Chips. __TOC__

Forest Chips are Core Chips in and . They can be dropped by Insectivore Malcom and Queen Arachnos in Gormott Province in , and the Sentinel Carpathia in the Kingdom of Torna in . Weapons forged with a Forest Chip deal 50% more damage against either beasts or insects. Forest Chips share their appearance with Flower Chips, Glass Chips, and Wood Chips. __TOC__
Fleet Moramoras (Japanese: , Furīto Moramora) are enemies in . They are members of the Moramora family, and can be found at level 41-46 at the Orl Cloudway: Fonsett in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Flow Bunnits (Japanese: , Furōu Banitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 31-35 at the Rigitte Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago. Two must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 3 Fuga Daemonum Blade Special.
Folmarie Inn is a shop in . It can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya's Fonsa Myma. It is an Inn run by Dellin. A Short Rest costs 150 to 300 G, depending on the Development Level of Uraya.
Flink Aligos (Japanese: , Furanku Diburo) are enemies in . They are members of the Aligo family, and can be found at level 29-36 at the Ansel Hatchery in the Leftherian Archipelago after Salvaging.
Fresh and Fruity is a quest in . It can be accepted from Twaina in the Grodd Residential Zone of Torigoth in the Gormott Province. Completing the quest unlocks the recipe for Sunshine Pie.

Fortis is an NPC in . He is King Eulogimenos' courtier and assistant who can be found in Theoscaldia Palace in the Kingdom of Tantal. He is a loyal servant of the king and can be seen beside his throne at all times. He is involved with Electra's quest Go for it, Electra!, where he complains of aching shoulders and Electra offers to give him an electrically charged shoulder massage. Doing so requires Level 2 "Electric Mastery", and Level 3 "Mastery of Thunder".

Follow Your Passion (Japanese: , Sukikosomono no Jōzunare) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received from Alban in Fonsa Myma Port in the Kingdom of Uraya after Gorg unlocks his level 3 Affinity Rewards and the Heart-to-Heart "Sweet Strategy" is viewed. After the quest in completed, Gorg may make desserts in Fonsa Myma. The items made during the quest are key items, while the items made afterward are consumable items.

Forward-Looking Woman is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Gotrock Oracle Ruins in the Cliffs of Morytha after staying at Aunt Corinne's House. The conversation concerns Kasandra's bad luck. It must be viewed to unlock her level 4 "Fortune" Battle Skill. During this heart-to-heart, the time is set to 17:00, and upon its completion, the weather at the Cliffs of Morytha will be set to storm until the party leaves the area.

The Fonsett-Rouge Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Shipping Lanes Closed. It enables the purchase of Fonsett-Rouge Lipgloss from the Aquaneze Cosmetics shop at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Float Medoozes (Japanese: , Furōto Jerī) are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Medooz family, and can be found at level 7-9 in the Cloud Tank Chamber of the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province during Chapters 2, 3 and 4.

Florid Spiral (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Zeke's Shredder Spiral.

Frenzied Fire (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Decimation Cannon. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Zeke's Haywire Chainshot.
Free as a Bird is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on the Isle of Urchon in the Leftherian Archipelago. It features a conversation between Obrona, her Driver and Akhos.
Flannick is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found on the Salvage Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild during the quest Go for it, Electra!. He is the father of Freigha.
Freigha is an NPC in . She is an Ardainian who can be found on the Salvage Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild during the quest Go for it, Electra!. She is the daughter of Flannick.
Frantias is an NPC in . He is a Leftherian who can be found at Ysheva Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Flash is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It allows Tora to start the battle with up to 2500 Aggro already accumulated. It is equivalent in effect to the Colorful Feather, Silver Feather and Phantom Feather accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

Front Attack is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases damage dealt while attacking from the front of the enemy by up to 50%. It can be used to customize Poppi α and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi QT is not compatible with this part. __TOC__
The Flowers of Ice are a Key Item in . They must be obtained at the center of the Argan Iceblooms in the Kingdom of Tantal during the quest The Writer's Assistant.

Foorara's Walky-Walky is an informal quest in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. It is initiated by speaking to Foorara, who can be found on a metal beam above Argentum's Salvage Deck. He tells the party he is on a "Walky-Walky", a traditional initiation of the Voltis Trade Guild. After this he moves on to various locations across Alrest. Each time he is spoken to, he gives a clue as to his next destination. If he is found and spoken to at each location in sequence, he rewards the party with a Blade Combo Boost IV, Endurance IV, and Resurrection Symbol. This quest does not appear in the quest log, so no means is provided for tracking one's progress, nor are Foorara's locations marked with the "!" icon.

Flutterheart Grass is a Key Item in . It can be obtained at the Sealed Quarry in the Kingdom of Tantal after starting the DLC Quest Making Love Source, which is part of the New Quests Pack 3 of the Expansion Pass. Flutterheart Grass is one of the ingredients needed to make Love Source at the Fiercest Fire. Only one Flutterheart Grass can be in the inventory at any one time. After the quest is completed, it will respawn at the Sealed Quarry, and will continue to do so every time it is used to make another Love Source.

Freja is an NPC in . She is a chronically ill Tornan child who can be found at Auresco in the Kingdom of Torna. Marena is her mother, and she is friends with Joey, Teeco and Marcus, who keeps trying to cure her illness with insect-derived home medicine. She is eventually cured using either the Dragon Incense or True Dragon Incense from Uraya. She involved during the quest Community Spirit, and her Community is gained alongside her mother's upon its completion.

Fred is an NPC in . He is a Tornan who can be found at Spefan Inn in the Auresco's Formide Shopping Ward in the Kingdom of Torna. He runs the Spefan Inn shop. He gives no quests himself, but is involved in Safety Measures, when he allow his inn to be converted into a secure bunker in case of an Aegis attack. Upon its completion his Community is gained alongside that of Wayton.

It must be passed through during The Quest for High Ether, as Zekr Marga Quarry can only be reached via the hushland. One Pororo's Favourite can be found here, beneath where Pororo stands on the plateau above. There is no music here.

Galvin (Japanese: , Gangu) is a pure-blooded High Entia in . He can be found at the bottom of the southern staircase in the Great Hall in Alcamoth, opposite of Lecrough, from 8:00 to 15:00. He occupies the same post as Galdo. After the events at Mechonis Core, he turned into a Telethia alongside most of his people. During A Merciful End, Rozeal asks the party to put Galvin out of his misery.

The place is located northeast of the Village Entrance and north of Clear Waterfall, and can be reached by using the bridge network from Frontier Village.

Gadolt (Japanese: , Gado, Gud; English dub: with silent lt) is a Homs in . He is Sharla's fiancé, with whom she had plans to marry after the attack on Colony 6. He is also the Colonel of the Defence Force in Colony 6. He is like a father to Juju. He is a bold man and wields a rifle, the only memento of him that Sharla has after the attack. He seems to get easily upset when it comes to the unnecessary loss of lives, which is shown in a flashback where he gets worked up after thirty men died and a fortress was overtaken. He is 26 years old.

The General's Cap (Japanese: , Homusu no Sōchōbō) is light head armour in . It is Dunban's initial head armour when he joins the party at Colony 6. The description implies that Dunban was once a general in the Defence Force at Colony 9 before he was crippled by the Monado at the first Battle of Sword Valley. The General's Cap is not otherwise obtainable. It is part of the General's set of armour along with the General's Attire, General's Gauntlets, General's Belt and General's Boots.
